lede: The biggest thing on the table this week is Ouray's joint work session Monday where county commissioners and city council sit down together to hash out a draft intergovernmental agreement that would hand full law enforcement for the City of Ouray to the Sheriff's Office starting January 1 — a structural change that includes a public comment period at 5:00 PM. Closer to home, Telluride Town Council meets Tuesday with a public hearing on a vesting period extension and a work session on automated license plate reader cameras, while San Miguel County's BOCC and Planning Commission both take up affordable housing policy and a public hearing on fee waivers for Mountain Village's Ilium Valley project.
